### SourceBackedBlockSelfBoxReentry { #sourcebackedblock-kt-sourcebackedblockselfboxreentry }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">SourceBackedBlockSelfBoxReentry</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">box</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Box</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">source</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">IllegalStateException</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;This source-backed block is evaluating its stored source in box '${box.name}' (${box.id}) — the &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;box that is running it, whose body it therefore re-runs, once per invocation, until the stack &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;overflows. Source: '${source.take(80).replace('&#92;n', ' ')}'. &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;Invoke it somewhere that is not this box's own body: &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;(1) from another box — construct it with that box's id, &#96;SourceBackedBlock&lt;Any?&gt;(&#92;&quot;other&#95;box&#92;&quot;, source)&#96;, &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;and invoke it there, which is the split &#96;dev&#95;docs/agents/transcripts/keyframe&#95;code&#95;blend.yaml&#96; uses; &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;(2) from a frame loop or a control callback, after this body has finished; or &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;(3) not at all — a block the &#96;sourceBlock { }&#96; macro made in &#42;this&#42; execution carries a live &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;lambda, never hydrates, and is safe to call immediately. &quot;</span> <span class="p">+</span> <span class="s">&quot;See dev&#95;docs/FN&#95;REWRITE&#95;SELF&#95;BOX&#95;REENTRY.md.&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/study/source/SourceBackedBlock/#L72)

Thrown when a rehydrating [`SourceBackedBlock`](internal.md#sourcebackedblock-kt-sourcebackedblock) would be evaluated in a box whose body is already running — the failure that was 327 nested body runs and 355 seconds before it was guarded.
